name: saddle
note: Art sample (round 4): the summit saddle of the Tsuzura-ori pass. Origin = the great camphor's trunk. x east, z south, heights in metres relative to the saddle crown. The home (the house, the shrine, the graves, the garden) lies under the camphor's crown inside a ring of sacred woods (the barrier, zones.sanctum) with three gates: the main one (two standing stones and a rope) at the foot of the stone steps of the approach (sando) south of the tree, the north one on the way down to the spring, the south-west one at the yard's gate. The old road passes outside, east of the ring; paved with stones over the pass and on the hairpins of the ninety-nine bends, earth elsewhere, with stone-step shortcuts down the inside of two hairpins. Round 5 (lead approved, coord/to_lead.md 2026-10-16): the approach climbs from the east gate in two flights of natural stone steps and a 延段 to the forecourt (境内), where a cut-stone 真 path leads straight to the shrine on its low stone platform; the iwakura sits behind it to the east, under the great camphor's ground limb; the house and its yard moved 3 m west behind a camellia hedge; plantings are authored (四层 + 林缘), not scattered.

pads.note: the forecourt (境内): level, fine gravel framed by moss; the 間 of the precinct
the shrine on a low platform of two courses of field stone (4 steps of 16 cm up from the forecourt), its back cut into the slope that rises to the iwakura
the graves on a narrow terrace that follows the contour; field stone only on the downhill side
the flat ground outside the east gate (where the fog puts her back without a lantern); the two gate cedars and the michikiri rope stand on it, so they lean alike (same base height)
level ground under the north gate's michikiri rope and its two cedars (same base height: they lean alike)
the landing (踊り場) between the two flights; the graves path leaves east

roads.layout: gzip of: per chunk: pos f32x3, normal f32x3, colour f32x4 (sRGB + AO), uv2 f32x2 (pattern, amount), index u32x3 (offsets into the inflated bytes)

cover.layout: per chunk: pos f32x3, normal f32x3, uv f32x2, uv2 f32x2 (px offset), colour f32x4 (tint + AO), custom0 f32x4 (anchor + flex), index u32x3

fog.note: Fog bands behind the gates' michikiri ropes (lead 2026-10-15 14:00): east thick and 5 m deep, north and south-west thinner. For the renderer's volumetric fog (a FogVolume per band): the band's polygon is zones.<key>, height above the ground, density 0..1. The loop (renderer): in the densest middle the screen whites out for 0.5-1 s and, without a lit bon lantern, she is put back on the outer side facing out ('out': the flat apron outside the gate). South-west: a reserved place on the west boundary, no path there yet.

camphor.note: Walk line on the great camphor (round 4b): from the foot of the ground limb G (north of the shrine, level with the ground) up G to the bowl on top of the trunk, east up P2, back west along P3 across the front of the trunk, round on P4 to the nest in the leader's fork. Points every 0.5 m on the top of the moss (object space of the tree; terrain.json climb.camphor has them in world space), width = what is walkable there. Slopes under 27 degrees: walk it like a slope, no climbing move.
